About me

Hello, I'm Butch.

I am a public administration professional with over 15 years in government service, more than 13 of them in local government fiscal administration and treasury operations. I designed and built ALTOS, the Automated Local Treasury Operations System.

I currently serve as Acting Municipal Treasurer of Sampaloc, Quezon, where I lead fiscal management, revenue forecasting, fund custody, and disbursement under RA 7160.

My grounding is in public administration, studied at both levels at Manuel S. Enverga University Foundation. I earned my Bachelor of Science in Public Administration through ETEEAP in 2008, while already working in government, and completed my Master in Public Administration in 2014. These studies gave me the theory behind my daily work: how local government is organized, how public money is planned, collected and accounted for, and why accountability must come first.

My technical background started with Computer System Design & Programming at AMA Computer Learning Center. I began learning on Coursera through Google Career Certificates (GCC) in 2020, during the pandemic, in Mulanay, Quezon, where I was first designated Acting Municipal Treasurer and served for two years. In 2024 I committed to the GCC program fully, and I have since completed seven Google Professional Certificates and three Google Specializations, covering data analytics, AI, cybersecurity, IT support, business intelligence, and project management.

ALTOS is where both worlds meet: a working treasury system for Philippine local treasuries, where every rule of collecting, disbursing and reporting public money is written into the software.
